Subtraction images (contrast phase minus pre-contrast phase, same parameters) are indispensable when a lesion is spontaneously hyperintense on T1 (blood, protein): they show only the signal increase due to contrast. Clear enhancement on the subtraction = solid component.
Clear cell carcinoma on MRI: hyperintense on T2 and heterogeneous; hemorrhage (T1 hyperintense foci) and necrosis are common; intense arterial enhancement; sometimes signal drop on out-of-phase images due to intracellular lipid. In the report: location, size, exophytic component, renal sinus, renal vein and vena cava, adrenal gland, lymph nodes, RENAL score.
Lesione già chiara in T1 prima del contr: Lesion already bright on T1 before contrast: judge enhancement on the subtraction images.
Nefrectomia: carcinoma renale della coor: Nephrectomy: renal carcinoma of the CPTAC-CCRCC clear cell cohort (GDC: renal cell carcinoma NOS, 8312/3), grade G2, pT1b. The GDC reports a diameter of 3 cm, inconsistent with pT1b (> 4 cm); on MRI the mass measures about 6 cm.
Neoplasia renale da trattare in elezione: Renal neoplasm to be treated electively.
